prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: best AI video ad maker depends on your use case
answer_verbatim:

HeyGen is ranked best overall for ads in one 2026 test because it handled avatar-driven ads, multilingual versions, and automated ad creation without needing another tool.[1] Creatify is described as the best overall by another review, especially for high-volume UGC-style performance ads and ecommerce workflows.[3][13] Revid.ai is the best overall AI video editor for short-form paid social ads if you want generation, captions, hooks, product-page videos, and publishing in one system.[17]

If you want a quick recommendation:
- **Best overall for general ad creation:** **HeyGen**[1][14]
- **Best for ecommerce / UGC-style performance ads:** **Creatify**[3][13]
- **Best for short-form paid social workflows:** **Revid.ai**[17]
- **Best low-cost option cited in the results:** **HeyFish** at $9.99/month, with 1,500+ AI actors and URL-to-video automation.[2]

A practical way to choose:
- Pick **HeyGen** if you need polished presenter-style ads, testimonials, or multilingual campaigns.[1][14]
- Pick **Creatify** if your main goal is fast ad volume for Meta, TikTok, or product ads.[3][13]
- Pick **Revid.ai** if you want an all-in-one short-form ad editor with automation and publishing tools.[17]

If you want, I can also narrow this down by **budget**, **platform** (TikTok/Meta/YouTube), or **ad style** (UGC, avatar, product demo).
